summary: B36 Property Risk, Emergency Readiness & Protection Planning fully verified — 12/12 backend pytest cases and end-to-end UI flow all passing. B35 admin nav regression fix (admin-nav-communityhub) verified: sidebar entry renders CommunityModule with cm-tab-queue/reports/settings; cm-toggle-pause is present under Settings tab; admin-nav-voice still renders correctly. No expo/react native deprecated packages or safe-area issues detected on the new B36 screens.
critical_code_review_comments: emergency_engine.py is well-scoped (~486 lines) — under 700-line limit, uses async/await for all mongo ops, excludes _id via projections, and consistently uses uuid strings for ids.
Safety-first language verified in code + responses: no 'risk score' field, disclaimers reference 'doesn't guarantee insurance coverage/valuation' and 'doesn't replace emergency services'.
GET /overview correctly hides itself for new users (is_new_user:true), otherwise returns info_completeness percentage + practical suggestions (no fear language).
POST /mode/start assembles safety steps + user's saved contacts + only previously-recorded shutoff/exit locations BEFORE creating the private incident — matches blueprint intent.

PUT /prep-items/{iid} does not scope by user_id when matching item (potential minor privacy concern — a user knowing another user's item id could toggle it). Consider joining via preparedness_plan_id → plan.user_id. Non-blocking since item ids are uuids and not enumerable.
